excerpt: Formally, a coupling map is a visual representation of the directed graph G = (V, E), where V = {vi} denotes the set of vertices representing the qubits and E = {ei,j} denotes the set of directed edges representing the possibility to perform a CNOT, with vi and vj acting as control and target qubit, respectively.
overview: The coupling-map equation supplies the formal object that distributed compilation must extend. The paper uses it to argue that a static graph is insufficient once remote operations depend on Bell-state availability and regeneration timing, motivating dynamic scheduling constraints.
title: Dynamic Coupling Map Model
